paleoarchean-era-begins.research_focus: Paleoarchean Earth: early stromatolites such as those of the Pilbara, shallow seas, volcanic islands and an oxygen-free sky
paleoarchean-era-begins.scene: Low domed stromatolite mounds rise from a still, shallow sea beside a bare volcanic shore; no plants, no animals

mesoarchean-era-begins.research_focus: Mesoarchean Earth: early cratons, photosynthesising microbes in the oceans, a hazy oxygen-poor atmosphere
mesoarchean-era-begins.scene: A broad slab of bare rock continent meets a calm sea whose shallows are carpeted in microbial mats; no plants, no animals

rhyacian-period-begins.research_focus: the early Paleoproterozoic after the Great Oxidation Event: banded iron formations and the Huronian glaciation
rhyacian-period-begins.scene: Glacial ice sheets grind toward a coast where layered banded-iron cliffs stand above a lifeless sea; no plants, no animals

mesoproterozoic-era-begins.research_focus: the Mesoproterozoic 'boring billion': stable climate, the supercontinent Columbia, early eukaryotic algae
mesoproterozoic-era-begins.scene: A tranquil tidal flat under a calm sky, rippled sand and pools filmed with simple algae stretching to a flat horizon; no animals

neoproterozoic-era-begins.research_focus: the early Neoproterozoic: the supercontinent Rodinia and the rifting that began its breakup
neoproterozoic-era-begins.scene: A vast barren landmass split by a long rift valley, lava welling along the crack and a new sea flooding in; no plants, no animals

cambrian-period-opens.research_focus: current reconstructions of the Cambrian explosion and the Burgess Shale fauna: trilobites, Anomalocaris, Opabinia
cambrian-period-opens.scene: A shallow sea floor teeming with trilobites, a large swimming Anomalocaris with grasping front limbs overhead, sponges rising from the mud

late-devonian-epoch-begins.research_focus: Late Devonian landscapes and seas: Archaeopteris forests, Dunkleosteus and other placoderms, Tiktaalik-like tetrapodomorphs
late-devonian-epoch-begins.scene: Beneath the overhanging trunks of an early tree forest at the water's edge, a huge armour-headed fish glides through a shallow river mouth

pennsylvanian-epoch-begins.research_focus: Pennsylvanian coal swamps: Lepidodendron and giant horsetails, Meganeura, Arthropleura, early reptiles such as Hylonomus
pennsylvanian-epoch-begins.scene: A steaming coal swamp of scale-barked lycopsid trees and towering horsetails, a giant dragonfly overhead and a small lizard-like reptile on a fallen log

late-triassic-epoch-begins.research_focus: the Carnian Pluvial Episode and Late Triassic Pangaea: early dinosaurs, rauisuchians and phytosaurs
late-triassic-epoch-begins.scene: Monsoon rain sweeps a fern-covered river plain where a small two-legged early dinosaur keeps its distance from a basking crocodile-like phytosaur

late-jurassic-epoch-begins.research_focus: Late Jurassic floodplains such as the Morrison Formation: sauropods, Stegosaurus, conifers and ferns
late-jurassic-epoch-begins.scene: A herd of long-necked sauropods grazes a lush river floodplain of conifers and ferns, a plated stegosaur in the foreground

late-cretaceous-epoch-begins.research_focus: the Late Cretaceous greenhouse world: high sea levels, the Western Interior Seaway, early flowering plants, tyrannosaurs and horned dinosaurs
late-cretaceous-epoch-begins.scene: On a warm coastal plain beside a shallow inland sea, a horned dinosaur faces a large tyrant dinosaur among flowering shrubs
